notes: ROS1 launch/XML-only package. /sound_controller/mode is set as an absolute-name <param> with value "cepstral" and no type attribute (roslaunch infers string) in five robot files: snapshot:cob_bringup/robots/cob3-2.xml:164, cob3-6.xml:155, cob3-9.xml:172, cob4-1.xml:206, cob4-2.xml:242; each is immediately followed by an include of $(find cob_bringup)/drivers/sound.launch. robots/raw3-4.xml:95 includes sound.launch without setting the param. drivers/sound.launch:5 starts pkg cob_sound type sound as ns="sound" name="sound_node", so the node's private namespace is /sound/sound_node, not /sound_controller; the param reader is outside this package and not in the snapshot. No packet element is consumed by this package, so references is empty.
